build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with two dynamic balls and a static bar with a hole
create_dynamic_balls: create dynamic ball bodies using C.add with scale and position setters
create_static_bars: create static bar bodies with configurable hole width using C.add and set_left set_right
update_task_relationships: update task metadata to define body relationships like TOUCHING between two balls
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata using C.set_meta with SolutionTier.PRE_BALL
